text:
maya: Heads up — GPU Savings Plan renewal window opens in ~6 weeks for a chunk in us-west-2. Utilization dashboard is showing a bunch of long-tail underused capacity :thinking_face:

alex: Do we have a SKU/instance-type split? I want to see p4 vs a100 breakdown and which ASGs are idling.

liam: Quick dump I pulled from billing: 
```
instance_type,region,hours_committed,hours_used,util_pct
p4d.24xlarge,us-west-2,43800,29200,66.7
a100.80gb,us-west-2,8760,2400,27.4
g5.48xlarge,us-west-2,4380,3800,86.8
```
Looks like the a100 buckets are the biggest problem.

infra-bot: Alert — SavingsPlan utilization below 50% for resource group: gpu-a100-cluster-usw2. Suggested action: run 7-day utilization scan and tag orphaned capacity.

sam: Agree with tagging. Also we have some long-running dev fleets spun up in us-west-2 for experiments that could be migrated to spot in us-east-1. Not all workloads require low latency to users in west.

alex: @finance-ops, do we have exchange options or partial conversion credits available for those A100 commitments? If we can exchange to p4 or shift regionally that could save churn.

finance-ops: Possible, but we need precise counts and dates. Exchange rules allow cross-AZ but cross-region exchanges are limited; there is a limited-window modification API. Please provide amortized utilization and a prioritized list.

maya: Proposed short plan: 1) run a 7-day high-granularity utilization query across tags; 2) identify ASGs + owners for <40% buckets; 3) offer migration to spot or scheduled shutdown windows; 4) evaluate partial-exchange vs let some commitments lapse.

liam: I pushed a quick BigQuery snippet to find low-util ASGs: 
```
SELECT cluster, SUM(used_hours)/SUM(committed_hours) as util
FROM `billing.gpu_reservations`
WHERE region='us-west-2' AND committed_hours>1000
GROUP BY cluster
HAVING util < 0.5
ORDER BY util
```
Run this and tag results with slack_owner.

maya: Can someone own the 7-day audit? I can take us-west-2 baseline. Need an owner for us-east migration feasibility and a list of candidates for exchange.

alex: I'll own exchange feasibility. I'll check exchange APIs and list convertible SKUs, and also price delta between p4 and a100 for nearest term.

sam: I'll coordinate with infra on migration playbook. Quick wins: (a) turn off non-prod evenings across us-west-2 clusters, (b) consolidate small clusters into pooled ASGs with auto-suspend, (c) apply capacity-weights to prefer cheaper zones.

infra-bot: Deploy job scheduled: run-util-scan (7d) started by maya — job id: run-util-211234. ETA ~45m.

finance-ops: Example deliverable request: CSV with columns [cluster,owner,instance_type,region,committed_hours,used_hours,util_pct,renewal_date,exchange_eligible]. Send before EOD next Wednesday to make the renewal cutoff.

maya: Noted. I'll attach the initial CSV here once scan finishes. After that we can decide: exchange, convert to shorter commit, or reduce coverage.

alex: If exchange isn't enough, remember Savings Plan change risk: partial exchanges may leave smaller residuals that hurt unit economics. We'll model 3 scenarios (exchange majority, stagger renewals, allow lapse & buy on-demand).

liam: Also flag networking constraints — some clusters pinned to peering-only subnets in us-west-2; migration might need temporary NAT/GW adjustments. I'll inventory subnet-level blockers.

sam: Good call. We'll add a "network friction" column to the CSV.

maya: Thanks team. Action items: liam run inventory + scan, alex exchange model, sam migration playbook, finance-ops template for CSV. Infra-bot will post scan results. Ping me if you need IAM for BQ access. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: run-util-scan (7d) completed — results uploaded to /s3/gpu-util/reports/run-util-211234.csv

maya: Uploaded and shared the CSV. Initial top-line: 18% of a100 commitments are <30% util; recommend we prioritize converting those to short-term commitments or migrating loads.

finance-ops: Received. Starting financial impact calc and breakeven window. Will post model by COB tomorrow.

alex: I'll post exchange feasibility by EOD today. If viable we'll prepare change request for reservations exchange team.

liam: Inventory shows 6 clusters with network blockers; I'll create tickets with required infra changes.

maya: Sweet. We'll reconvene next week after models. Thanks everyone.
